claim: The workflow separates product design, technical design, and program design so user choices and implementation choices are reviewed at different stages.
In this workflow, the design spec is the reviewed artifact; one example had 112 team comments before implementation.

claim: A product spec should define measurable success so a later agent can check whether the shipped change improved the target outcome.
The live workflow generated several HTML mockup options, then selected an artifact-focused layout through human review.
Markdown is preferred for model-facing research because it is token efficient, while rendered HTML is preferred for rich human review.
A pull request section that lists deviations from the plan lets reviewers focus on likely bug locations without reading every changed line first.
The speakers summarize the stage rule as broader exploration early and stronger verification later.
Program design surfaced a provider-versus-TanStack decision before code, preventing a common unwanted React pattern.
